name: Plasma Field
description: Ionized matter intelligence manifesting in self-organized electromagnetic structures. Bridge between matter and energy domains.

core_attributes.pattern: ionized feedback, magnetized flow, phase coherence

scope.definition: Electrostatic shielding efficiency of plasma Debye sphere — fractional reduction in potential at Debye length λ_D from a test charge, compared to Coulomb potential in vacuum.

evidence.source: Debye & Hückel (1923) 'Zur Theorie der Elektrolyte', Physikalische Zeitschrift 24:185-206; Chen (1984) 'Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion', 2nd ed., Plenum.
cross_domain_examples: Debye shielding: potential drops to e⁻¹ ≈ 37% of vacuum Coulomb at λ_D — exponential screening
in Earth's magnetosphere: Debye length 10-100 m — sets minimum scale for collective plasma behavior
electrolyte Debye shielding (Debye-Hückel): same mathematics for ionic solutions — biological cell membrane environment

scope.falsifiability: If probe measurements in laboratory plasma show Coulomb potential decay slower than exp(-r/λ_D), Debye shielding is incomplete and charge neutrality is not maintained on Debye scales.
scope.measurement_limits: Debye shielding requires many particles within Debye sphere (Λ = n·λ_D³ >> 1). Ultra-dense or ultra-cold plasmas may not satisfy this condition. Measurement requires non-perturbing Langmuir probe.
